statements.status_notes: GO-2026-6225 flags github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env, which has no fixed release in that module. The helper is linked through sigstore/cosign registry keychain wiring and go-containerregistry k8schain (OCIRepository reconciler calls k8schain.NewFromPullSecrets for user-configured registry URLs). A maintained fork (osscontainertools/docker-credential-acr v0.8.0) contains the anchored-regex fix, but a go.mod replace to that module fails with a dual module-path conflict during go mod tidy. Published sigstore/cosign v2 and v3 releases through v3.1.3 still depend on chrismellard. Under investigation pending upstream cosign migration or a compatible remediation.

GO-2026-6225 affects the unmaintained github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env module (no fixed release). Kubescape v4.0.12 pulls it in indirectly through helm.sh/helm/v3. Replacing it with github.com/gaganhr94/docker-credential-acr@v1.0.2 via go mod replace fails because helm also resolves the maintained module directly, producing a dual module-path conflict at go mod tidy. Until helm upstream drops the legacy import or kubescape can adopt a release that no longer needs it, the finding remains visible on v4 variants.
